name: market_state_classifier_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's intraday order flow alternates between institutional TWAP/VWAP-driven trending phases (persistent directional imbalance visible as rising 2-minute ADX) and market-maker-driven ranging phases (tight oscillation as gamma-hedgers quote both sides within a narrow band). When NIFTY ADX(24) rises above 22 with contained ATR acceleration, it signals institutional directional programs are active — a short EMA crossover (EMA12 crossing EMA36) aligned with VWAP confirms the next 30-50 spot point leg has begun, exploitable with a 30-90 second options hold. Conversely, when ADX(24) falls below 18 and Bollinger Band width sits in the bottom 40th percentile of its 5-minute history, market makers are the marginal price-setters — price touching the outer band immediately encounters their resting contra-side hedging flow, producing reliable 15-25 spot point mean-reversion within 30-60 seconds.

indicators.name: adx_24
indicators.formula: ADX(high, low, close, 24) via Wilder's smoothing
indicators.purpose: 2-minute ADX (24 × 5s bars) to classify NIFTY micro-regime into trending vs ranging. Original used ADX(14) on 1-min bars (14-minute window). We compress to 2-minutes because our hold time is 30-90s — a 14-minute ADX would flag as 'trending' well after the institutional leg has already run. 2-minute ADX detects whether the MOST RECENT 2 minutes of NIFTY price action shows directional progress vs oscillation, which is exactly the right resolution for 30-90s entry timing.

indicators.name: bb_width_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute Bollinger Band normalized width. Original used BB(20) on 1-min bars = 20-minute window. At 5-second resolution, 60 bars = 5 minutes, capturing the current trading session micro-regime without historical contamination. Normalized by midline so NIFTY's absolute price level doesn't inflate the width measure.

indicators.name: bb_width_pctile
indicators.purpose: Percentile rank of current BB width within the last 60 bars (5 minutes of history). A low percentile (below 40th) means the current range is tighter than 60% of recent 5-minute bars — a genuine squeeze. Adapted from original's BB_Width_Pctile(20, 60-bar window) which used 1-min bars; same 5-minute history window but now evaluated at 5-second granularity.

indicators.name: atr_acceleration
indicators.purpose: 1-minute ATR acceleration: current 1-min ATR (ATR over 12 × 5s bars) divided by the same metric from 12 bars (60 seconds) ago. A value > 0.6 means ATR has expanded 60% in 60 seconds — a sudden volatility spike from news, stop-run, or macro event on NIFTY. Adapted from original's ATR(14)[bar] / ATR(14)[10 bars back] on 1-min charts; same concept at 5s granularity. This blocks entries during explosive moves where neither trend nor range thesis holds.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute fast EMA (12 × 5s). Compressed from EMA(9) on 1-min bars in the original. At 5-second resolution, 12 bars = 1 minute, giving a fast trigger line responsive enough to detect the start of new institutional legs on NIFTY without being noise-driven.

indicators.name: ema_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute slow EMA (36 × 5s). Compressed from EMA(21) on 1-min bars (21 minutes in original → 3 minutes here). Ratio EMA_fast/EMA_slow is preserved: original was 9/21 ≈ 0.43; here 12/36 = 0.33, slightly more separation given we're holding 30-90s not 20-60 min. The 3-min EMA captures the current short-term trend context on NIFTY.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: VWAP(cumulative from session open at 09:15 IST)
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as intraday directional bias filter. No scaling needed — cumulative from open. Same role as original: trending entries must align with the dominant intraday VWAP direction to avoid fading institutional flow. VWAP above price = institutions net sellers intraday; below = net buyers.

indicators.name: bb_upper_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute upper Bollinger Band. Used in RANGING state for bearish entry (buy PE). Price tagging the upper band during a confirmed squeeze signals market-maker contra flow is about to push NIFTY back toward the midline.

indicators.name: bb_lower_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute lower Bollinger Band. Used in RANGING state for bullish entry (buy CE). Price touching the lower band in confirmed squeeze conditions signals resting buy orders from market-maker hedges will absorb the dip and push NIFTY back up.

conditions: TRENDING: adx_24 > 22 AND atr_acceleration < 0.6 AND ema_12 crosses above ema_36 AND close > vwap
RANGING: adx_24 < 18 AND bb_width_pctile < 40 AND close <= bb_lower_60 AND close < vwap
TRENDING: adx_24 > 22 AND atr_acceleration < 0.6 AND ema_12 crosses below ema_36 AND close < vwap
RANGING: adx_24 < 18 AND bb_width_pctile < 40 AND close >= bb_upper_60 AND close > vwap

exit.stop_rationale: TRENDING entries use 5 option pts (≈10 NIFTY spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5). A confirmed institutional leg on NIFTY that reverses 10 spot pts within 30s means the TWAP flow has finished or reversed — thesis is broken. RANGING entries use 3 option pts (≈6 spot pts); a squeezed NIFTY that moves 6 pts against the mean-reversion direction has broken the range (BB band penetration) and will not revert quickly. The two-tier approach matches the different edge sizes per state.
exit.target_rationale: TRENDING entries target 8 option pts (≈16 NIFTY spot pts). Institutional micro-legs on NIFTY extend 20-40 spot pts from EMA crossover confirmation; 8 pts captures roughly the first 40-50% of the expected move (1:1.6 R:R). RANGING entries target 5 option pts (≈10 spot pts); a 5-min BB extreme to midline mean-reversion on NIFTY averages 15-25 spot pts, capturing 40-65% at 5 pts (1:1.67 R:R).

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; ATR acceleration > 0.6 forces VOLATILE classification (no entries regardless of ADX or BB state)
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:30 IST (opening range absorption period) or after 15:20 IST (expiry day flatten)
filters.volume_filter: None explicit — index volume in 5-second bars is too noisy; ADX regime classification is the quality gate
filters.trend_filter: TRENDING entries require close > VWAP (for CE) or close < VWAP (for PE) to align with the dominant intraday direction
filters.spread_filter: None — limit order execution at candle close, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — ADX/BB state classification is robust but specific thresholds (ADX=22, ADX=18, BB_pctile=40) may require periodic recalibration as NIFTY intraday volatility regime shifts across market cycles

adaptation_notes: Original operated on NIFTY50 individual constituents at 1-min resolution (universe-level operation). Converted to the NIFTY index itself with 5-second bars and 30-90s holds. Key changes: (1) Universe collapsed from 50 stocks to the single NIFTY index — the state classification now describes the INDEX's own regime, not individual stocks. This actually improves signal quality because individual stocks have idiosyncratic noise; the index is smoother and more reliably ADX-classifiable. (2) ADX(14 min) compressed to ADX(2 min): at 5-second resolution, a 14-minute ADX would perpetually lag the micro-regime transitions relevant to 30-90s holds. (3) BB(20 min) compressed to BB(5 min): same reasoning — current range conditions matter, not conditions from 20 minutes ago. (4) EMA(9)/EMA(21) on 1-min bars → EMA(12)/EMA(36) on 5-second bars = EMA(1 min)/EMA(3 min). The fast/slow ratio is preserved. (5) Added normalized BB width (divided by midline) to handle NIFTY's absolute level changes. (6) Eliminated per-stock earnings and delivery% filters — not applicable to index. (7) VOLATILE state (atr_accel > 0.6) now suppresses entries for that bar; the time_stop_bars=18 mechanism handles exits. (8) Dropped trailing stop and signal-exit-on-state-change from original — both incompatible with 5-second bars and the pipeline's binary option structure.
weaknesses: 2-minute ADX on NIFTY will oscillate around thresholds during macro-driven choppy days (high volume but no sustained direction) — generating false TRENDING entries
EMA(12)/EMA(36) crossovers fire frequently on NIFTY's 5-second bars; the ADX filter is critical but during trending periods, multiple crossovers will fire per trend leg, potentially entering late
BB width percentile rank requires 120 bars (10 min of warmup) before it becomes reliable; early session ranging signals (09:30-09:40 IST) may have biased percentile ranks
ADX 'dead zone' between 18 and 22 generates no trades — NIFTY frequently operates in this intermediate-trend state which represents missed opportunity

The state is classified per bar independently; a genuine state transition (trending → ranging) will still generate a new trending entry on the first bar of the new bar if indicators haven't updated yet
